name: Biorestaurant Garmischer Hof

beschreibung: The Biorestaurant Garmischer Hof in Garmisch-Partenkirchen serves creative organic cuisine in a welcoming Bavarian-Tyrolean ambiance. With a commitment to 100% certified organic quality, the kitchen transforms local seasonal products into hearty classics and contemporary dishes. The charming wood-paneled dining parlors invite guests to linger and enjoy a meal in style, whether arriving after a mountain hike or celebrating with family.
